- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.25) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for 30d horizon.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes (sentiment < -0.1) — add 2–5% to forecast to avoid underreaction.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below peak of prior 5d range.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 30d forecast is > 10% above recent 10d average, reduce by 5–10%.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment > 0.35 for 3 consecutive days, forecast should be 5–8% lower than model output.
- Horizon-specific: 30d forecasts tend to overreact to short-term sentiment — apply 3–5% downward adjustment if sentiment is volatile or > 0.4.
